verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own docs say it works with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more frameworks, and that server-side auth uses `auth.api` methods. A user reports moving from Next.js to Hono by changing only the router, which supports first-party framework integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows route-protection middleware or session verification at the edge, so only the framework-SDK part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware (e.g., Next.js middleware helpers), edge-runtime session verification, per-framework integration docs, hands-on corroboration of protected routes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge

citations.quote: Works with your stack. Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ more.
To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the `auth.api` methods.
They migrated from Next.js to Hono and only had to change the router.
